# An indexed process wiki with just-in-time reading
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #234, sha256:d627b0dd5d91d581da0d6c49a9528837c0d21c8d28ee7c7e9509cdbf145cfbfe). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Done 2026-11-01 (the process wiki with an index, routed briefs, verbatim-quoted rules, a restart from the wiki against a committed key, and source-checked token values; the experiment verdict is REVISE: not yet promoted to the template)
- **Shape:** Contract
- **Type:** process experiment (product owner priority ruling 2026-11-01: highest priority; stop-the-line waiver D170)
- **Repository:** avowry and mob-defaults (the working agreement, rules, decisions, role charters and how-tos; seat briefs; the facilitator's handoff notes)
- **Source:** the product owner rules this the highest priority. Every turn re-reads the whole context, so fresh seats overpay by reading everything (baseline about 50K tokens at setup and about 125K median at the end), and the long facilitator session overpays on every turn (now about 965K). Split the process into small pages under one index, so each seat reads only what its role and step need, and the facilitator keeps state in the wiki and handoff notes so it can restart cheaply at any boundary. The product owner also gets one readable place for the whole process.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Actor:** every seat and the facilitator
- **Given:** the working agreement, rules, decisions, role charters and how-tos
- **Observes:** small pages, each with a one-line summary, under one index page; every seat gets the index instead of the whole agreement and reads only the pages its role and step need; the facilitator keeps its state in the wiki and handoff notes
- **Fails with:** a seat that misses a rule because it did not read a page it needed is recorded as a counter-metric case
- **Invariants:** rules keep their decision anchors and history; the decisions index still builds; the checks still read the rules
- **Enables:** card 216 (if the experiment passes its keep verdict, the template carries the index and the just-in-time pages through the normal template-change path, including the template review)
- **One observable behaviour:** Small pages, each with a one-line summary, under one index page; every seat gets the index instead of the whole agreement and reads only the pages its role and step need; the facilitator keeps its state in the wiki and handoff notes.
- **Done checks (at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. The process is split into indexed pages with one-line summaries, and every rule still resolves to its decision. ZOMBIES to be written by QA at ready.
  2. Seat briefs give the index and the needed pages only; tokens per seat are measured against the baseline (about 50K at setup and about 125K median at the end). ZOMBIES to be written by QA at ready.
  3. The facilitator restarts from the wiki and handoff notes at a boundary; its context size is measured against about 965K, and rule misses from an unread page are counted. If the experiment's review gives a keep verdict, the index and the just-in-time pages are promoted into the mob-defaults template, so every new mob starts with them, through the normal template-change path including the template review (product owner's defaults-promotion note, 2026-11-01). ZOMBIES to be written by QA at ready.
- **Not in this card:** anything the source does not name.
